data.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Dallas Dallas, TX

reviews.text: The scheduling of the service was fast and easy. Jody was very helpful in getting the appointment set up. David arrived and began troubleshooting the situation to determine the cause of my problem. He explained everything completely and performed his job in a very timely, thorough and professional manner. Very pleased with today’s service.

We needed emergency work on Saturday and Sunday and these people are awesome. Tun is the best. He was thorough and explained everything to us in great detail. He made everything so easy to understand and is the ultimate professional.

Mr. Rooter came to my home to check for a leak.  When Clint arrived and tested the city water meter, he found that there was no water leaking.  His only job was to check for any leaks.  However, when I informed him that my water bill was over $400 and that another company came out to repair a toilet leak and replace a shower cartridge, Clint wanted to add this in his report.  I asked him not to do that because I would be sending the water department my invoice from the other company and just to

This company is amazing. They truly are available 24/7 and Tun was wonderful to work with. Very kind, empathetic and knowledgeable. He assured me that he could resolve our issue and he did. Very professional young man. I highly recommend Mr. Rooter!

Paid $907. Roto rooted roots. Informed they would eventually grow back. Told I need to replace pipes for 10k, so no warranty. Same issue happened again 7 days later. Came out today. Wants to charge more to fix what wasn’t fixed 7 days ago. Based on his logic, had the issue happened the following day after paying $907, returning the following day would have resulted in more money. Why not complete what the $907 paid for? So upsetting. Shame on you. That was already expensive by comparison for wha

Getting an appointment was very easy using the online website. I explained what I needed and all was documented well by the online bot. Although I did opt for the morning appointment, the dispatcher called to let me know someone was coming, but it was close to noon. Tun was my tech and he explained everything throughly with the cost and I agreed to have the work done. I had him remove old copper sweated supply lines and valve cutoffs for Mt bathroom sink and also install a new sink and flex supp

Clint diagnosed the region of the clog and promptly got to work. He thoroughly explained the cause of the problem and also found a small leak I wasn’t aware of. Clint explained all costs involved then unstopped the clog and made repairs. He was friendly, professional and left his workspace clean.
Matthew Wheeler  did a great job. He was knowledgeable, worked fast, and was very respectful of our property.

They came out to provide a quote for replacing my water heaters and quoted me $10,500. I told them that was crazy high and didn't want to proceed and now they are trying to charge me $300 for the quote alone. I ended up getting the work done for only $4,000. Don't let them scam you.

Professional, knowledgeable and friendly.
Brent arrived within 30 minutes and took care of blockage and showed us the  condition of our main line and future possibilities.

Clinton did a fantastic job!  He identified the issues and thoroughly explained the problem issues and the proposed repairs.  Highly recommend Mr. Rooter!  We have used them in the past and will use them again.

We had a bad experience. We called Mr. Rooter because our main water pipe in the front yard had a leak. The plumber came out and said he couldn't warranty his work because the pressure in the pipes were too high going to the house. He fixed the pipes, buried it and two weeks, it started leaking again. I knew he wouldnt warranty his work, so I called Roto Rooter. They thought the work completed by the Mr Rooter was not a plumber. The fix had metal pinched down so hard, a leak sprung. Also, the ho

Sinatra is very knowledgeable and took the time to walk me through each step of the process of replacing the sewer line from the house to the street.  The team did a great job and would use again and recommend!

Requested emergency service at about 12:00 a.m. after contacting several 24/7 companies that were unavailable. The tech called within 30 minutes to assess the issue, and was at our door less than an hour after that (only because the drive time was 50+ minutes). Even at 1:30 a.m., he was buttoned-up, personable, and efficient. Went straight to work, and had us taken care of quickly with no real disruption. The fee was reasonable given the problem and the urgency. While I hope I never have to, I w

Jacky was great ! Diagnosed the problem quickly  & fixed  my  issue &  Offered  a few business  cards.  Happy to refer Jacky to other's. Great experience  !

Derrick

Customer service was great.  Dispatch was able to get Clint out within the hour. Clint was detailed and very thorough.  In addition, he was very nice and explained the whole process.  Reasonable price for the amount of work.  I highly recommend.

The price he quoted was extremely overpriced. We had another company come out today. The price they charged was less than half of what Mr. Rooter wanted to charge for a bathroom faucet leak. Maybe we don't understand because we're not plumbers. Jacky was professional.

We had them install a new faucet and garbage disposal. They were punctual, respectful of our home, and took the time to show us how the new disposal worked. The price was exactly what was quoted, with no surprise charges.
I give David a 5 star rating.  He was wonderful and the job he did was amazing. I am very pleased with the work and how pleasing to the eye his work looked for the street.  He is wonderful!!

After losing a war with a shower valve, high pressure water was shooting out into our master bath and bedroom.  In the time it took to turn off the main water line to our home, Mr Rooter notified one of their technicians, Kiefer, and he was here very quickly.   Kiefer was efficient and knowledgeable.  He made sure no additional damage occurred because of the high pressure of water. Unfortunately there was. He showed me the split parts that had to be repaired, went to obtain the needed part, and

Over all good experience. Came right out on day called and they had there hands full with this major leak. Mo handled it the ground was dug up pipes replaced inspection following day we did have to wait an extra day for them to cover it all back in but they did a great job.

Very professional.  The service required digging under my foundation and was super expensive but came with a 2-year warranty. They took great care of my yard.  Previously I have had to purchase sod after a repair, so I was thrilled with the result.

Pasqual met me outside and we introduced ourselves and he asked me about my plumbing problems.  Not sure I explained it well, we went in and checked the Master bathroom sink and commode.  Next went to second bathroom and checked commode.  He felt he knew what was happening and explained that and wrote up an estimate and I agreed to work and he got started.  He fixed the drainage problem in the sink and the commode and then moved onto the other commode.  Think he needed a part, so he went to stor
Quick service on a Sunday. The tech,Tun, was very pleasant and friendly. Fair price for a job well done.

Mr. Rooter Plumbing was able to get us scheduled same day (on a weekend). Jacky was our plumber, and he worked on the issue all day diligently. He kept us incredibly informed and was forthcoming, kind, and upfront about everything. He went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable, and he helped us to prioritize repair issues. We're glad that we have found a new, trustworthy plumber in him and Mr. Rooter!
This is the 2nd time I have used Mr Rooter.  Thankfully I was able to have Jeff Larson both times.  He is terrific!  He is a great communicator and an expert!  Thank you Jeff for a job well done!

Over priced... I took the $800 estimate to ARS plumbing and they came out snaked  the main line then used camera  for a total of $99.
I'm sure both techs are great guys but rescue roster was waaay more affordable

Jeff Larson was fantastic! He went above and beyond to repair our gas line. I highly recommend the professionals at Mr. Rooter

Just had Jeff back to clean out a clogged sink (the gas work was done 2 months ago). Very professional and friendly.

Thank you Pascual Adame for your service. He found a broken pipe in the yard we thought was a blockage. He was out the next day only because he needed a digging crew and fixed it. He provided me with a few options and we found what would work best for my situation. Costly repair but glad they were able to help very fast.

Tun was out less than an hour after calling.  Very helpful on the issues that we were having. I would recommend him and the company to anyone!  Thank you for coming out so late and helping us find out what’s going on with our plumbing.

Plumber explained what appeared to be problem and his course of action. He also explained what the next action would be if first didn't work. First worked. He saw my cats and asked if he needed to take care so they didn't get out as he came in and out of the house. Very considerate of him.
Brett was kind enough to come two days, while we waited for the City to unblock the meter and turn off the water. I appreciated his patience and willingness to get the job done.

Great service, great company. They’ve done work for me several times and I’m always happy with the work and they always make sure that I understand exactly what they’re doing and why. They never try to upsell, ever.
Came out in a timely manner the same day, quoted the work and had it completed the next day. Will definitely use them in the future.

Ian came to the house after 11PM - assessed the repair needs thoroughly, shut the water off to deal with the reported leak - very detailed in updates to the work - Today Jeff completed all the needed repairs in a very timely manner - The area is now much clearer as he removed old connections and valves replacing with up-to-date hardware. Very impressed with the Mr. Rooter team and their expertise.

Needed an emergency plumber for clogged and overflowing drain that was dripping through the floor and damaged the ceiling- called Mr Rooter and they sent a young man who in 30 minutes who completely took care of the problem - unclogged bathroom drain and checked AC condensate line and put us in touch with their restoration team. That team called us within 15 minutes of the technician leaving and scheduled an appointment for the morning to tell us about how to take care of the damage. Great and q
Keyfer was very friendly and professional.  He was courteous as well.  Knew what to look for and gave me recommendations for the additional help needed.  He was very good at what he does.

AT&T contractor drilled through our main sewer line while installing fiber optic cable in our neighborhood. Jeff DuBose was our Plumber and he and his team did a fantastic job. They cleared the line, videoed the line, located and check the nature of the damage which was near our large live oak tree. They excavated, repaired the line,  and the job was completed by the next day. They provided amazing and responsive service at a reasonable price and I would definitely use them again.
Jeff Larson of Mr. Rooter was prompt and professional. He identified my water problem and told me how to resolve it. I was very pleased with his service.

As a plumber, the person should be aware of issues and not directly go to the cutting the wall. He came to my house and before going up and down the stairs, looking at different faucets, and whatever is in front of our eyes, he cut the wall, charged me a lot for it, and now I have to pay someone to come fix the wall. This all could’ve easily been avoided if he looked for alternative sources of the leak rather than assuming it’s the wall.

First time I encountered Mr. Rooter Plumbing, I was very satisfied by the technician knowledge, experience, and kindness. This visit was completely different. I wanted to fix the problem I had and at the end I received even bigger problem and not very kind explanation how I don't understand that this supposed to work exsectly like this and Mr. Master Plumber knows better. My satisfaction of today's service is below zero. I am very disappointed!

Jacky was phenomenal!!! Showed up on a Sunday morning with a gentle touch and the presentation of a true educator. He volunteered his cell phone number halfway through the process and is very responsive. I will go straight to him for any future plumbing issues. Money well spent.
Tun was easy to work with. Explained the ins and outs very well. Everything went exactly how he said it would. Plus he had a great attitude. Would highly recommend

Clinton from Mr. Rooter showed up promptly and completed the job efficiently and to my satisfaction. The work was done at the agreed-upon price, with no surprises. I’m happy with the service and will definitely use them again.
Clinton Walker absolutely cleared my problem. Courteous, knowledgeable, and friendly, He made sure the issue was resolved for me. 2 thumbs up!!!

Clinton was wonderful. Super polite and very knowledgeable. He knew exactly what the issue was and fixed it. One thing I appreciated the most was that he didn't talk to me like I had no idea what was going on. I have had many repair men talk to me poorly. Clinton was great. We will definitely be a return customer and ask for him specifically.

Review for Roto-Rooter Technician – Jeff (June 25, 2025)

I had a great experience with Roto-Rooter thanks to their technician, Jeff. He came out on June 25, 2025, to work on our water heater and was incredibly professional from start to finish. Jeff arrived on time, was very thorough in diagnosing and explaining the issue, and made sure the job was done right.

The service cost was “pretty penny” and while that’s a significant investment, I felt confident in the quality of work and the professi
He was polite but didn’t clean the toilet bowl afterwards.  I also thought the service charge was high - $227.50!!!
Jeff is an outstanding plumber. He made sure that work done by another company was replaced correctly.  I highly recommend Mr. Rooter.

Mr. Rooter was great!!
They were able to send someone out very quickly, and the technician, Clint, was able to solve our drainage issue completely!  He was very up front and informative through the entire process.
If we have any future issues, we will definitely be using them again, and we will recommend them to others! Thank you!
